sections.text: Introduction

This procedure details the steps required to 
 completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 220kv busbar 
 differential relay I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1in the title block.

The document is formatted the way to minimize 
 the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Raheem Salem 
 Mohamed Ez, 
 tested by eng. Khaled El-Etreby & eng. Atef Farh 
 at 10 July 2002, revised 
 by quality control eng. Tawfik Elabasery at EDEPCo., and approved by eng. 
 Monear Mahmoud El-Wakeel: Head Sector of 
 Damietta 
 Power Station.
Safety Precautions

A work 
 permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category,

Maintenance 
 staff should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who 
 is

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, 
 Helmet).
Disconnect the DC supply (F001, F002) .

Remove 
the trip cards 7TR29004 .
Connect the DC supply (F001, F002) .

Connect 
the terminal socket between the tester and the relay .
Normal operation of station two busbar in service.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
First test during test socket
All equipment in service, two BBs energize.

Test during 
socket 7VX6642-4H & selection switch S11 which select the selection 
(BorA1orB1) For test and isolate its trip signal as follow:
B normal operation
A1 test and isolate trip of BBI + check
B1 test and isolate trip of BBII + check
Test BBI + CHECK
Select the section A1 by S11 to test the BB1 and check.

Select L1 & N in the tester and inject current through the test socket increase 
the current until the lamp lights { I --- trip& II ---- start & III ---- 
block } for BBI. Record the values of I trip , I start & 
I block .

Measure mv Dc for operating coil through Bu1, Bu2 and measure mv Dc for 
Restraining coil through Bu3, Bu4 at lamp light , record these values .

Select L2 & N in the tester and inject current through the test socket increase 
the current until the lamp lights { I ---- trip & II ---- start & III ---- 
block } for check . Record the values of I trip , I start 
& I block .

Measure mv Dc for operating coil through Bu1, Bu2 and measure mv Dc for 
Restraining coil through Bu3, Bu4 at each lamp light , record these values.
